purpose: Evidence-backed hardware compatibility registry with human-readable family comparison

PM5.human_summary: Newer PM5 hardware family. The exact board revision, USB identifiers and subsystem versions must be detected from the physical device before firmware selection.
PM5.firmware_rule: Never select a firmware package solely because it appears in a Proxmark3 repository. Resolve the exact PM5 hardware identity first.

PM3.human_summary: Legacy/reference family used by the RfidResearchGroup proxmark3 software ecosystem. It is a compatibility reference, not proof of PM5 compatibility.
PM3.firmware_rule: PM3 firmware is not assumed to be compatible with PM5. Reusable protocol code must be verified independently.

notes: Do not add a hardware revision, VID, PID or memory value until it is supported by reliable evidence.
The first physical PM5 session should create the first observed entry.
Expected compatibility values must never be presented as detected values.
The UI should explain differences in human terms, not only show hexadecimal identifiers.
selection_pipeline: Determine hardware family and exact revision
Only then offer a matching firmware package
